name: sitepull
description: Pull the web apart: a cross-platform desktop utility and CLI for browser-delivered design references.
author: Isaiah Neal

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @sitepull/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/core build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/desktop start
scripts.dev:cli: pnpm --filter @sitepull/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/core build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/cli dev
scripts.build:cli: pnpm --filter @sitepull/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/core build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/cli build
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm --filter @sitepull/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/core build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/desktop build
scripts.package:desktop: pnpm --filter @sitepull/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/core build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/desktop package
scripts.package:mac: pnpm --filter @sitepull/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/core build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/desktop package:mac
scripts.package:linux: pnpm --filter @sitepull/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/core build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/desktop package:linux
scripts.package:windows: pnpm --filter @sitepull/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/core build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/desktop package:windows
scripts.make:desktop: pnpm --filter @sitepull/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/core build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/desktop make
scripts.make:mac: pnpm --filter @sitepull/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/core build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/desktop make:mac
scripts.make:linux:ubuntu24: pnpm --filter @sitepull/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/core build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/desktop make:linux:ubuntu24
scripts.make:linux:debian12: pnpm --filter @sitepull/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/core build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/desktop make:linux:debian12
scripts.make:linux:debian13: pnpm --filter @sitepull/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/core build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/desktop make:linux:debian13
scripts.make:windows: pnpm --filter @sitepull/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/core build && pnpm --filter @sitepull/desktop make:windows
